newsitem.title: GERMANY: German bourse says now updating DAX every 15 secs.
newsitem.headline: German bourse says now updating DAX every 15 secs.

text.p: The German bourse said on Friday the DAX index would, with immediate effect, be updated every 15 seconds instead of every minute.
The bourse said both the 30-share DAX index and IBIS DAX index, which reflects all-day computer dealings, will be updated every 15 seconds.
The IBIS best-bid and IBIS best-ask indices will also be updated every 15 seconds.
The VDAX index, which tracks implied volatility of the DAX index, will be updated every minute starting from July 14, speeding up the daily updates currently available.
In addition, eight new sub-indices will be added to the VDAX series, each of which will correspond to the individual expiry dates on DTB options contract on the DAX.
Updating intervals on all other indices will remain as before, the bourse said.
Germany's Deutsch Terminboerse said earlier this week that it planned to introduce a futures contract based on the implied volatility of the DAX share index as soon as possible.
